scope: Independently reconstruct original primary closed PAPER cash before archival, forward evidence and model-label consumption. Preserve 0.1 SOL PAPER, uncapped runners and all runtime OFF; no operator model/policy, provider, wallet or order activation.

finding.reproduction: Five isolated expected-rejection tests failed on the original source: direct forward evidence accepted coherent changed gross USD, USD fees and SOL proceeds; original model source validation also accepted rehashed changed USD fees and SOL proceeds. All inputs were temporary synthetic actual PAPER buy/sell receipts, not operator trades.
finding.repair: Reconstruct raw output cash less frozen slippage for every original sell, value each cash/fee with its own original FX, conserve exact ordered quantities and validate original normalized prices. Recheck primary partial-prefix fields independently from the final sale. Both archive and direct forward consumers enforce this contract; learning uses the archive contract and wraps invalid financial sources consistently.

financial_contract.entry: Original checked PAPER buy identity/signature, mint, typed raw quantity and amount, complete entry quote at original event age, frozen cost model and typed original entry FX exactly at its original opening clock.
financial_contract.exit: Complete unique ordered successful PAPER partial-to-final receipt population. Exact quantity before/sold/left, original intent/signature, normalized quoted price, mint/limit/age, original fill FX and terminal clock are conserved.
financial_contract.cash: Sum original quoted SOL proceeds less frozen slippage and separately converted USD proceeds; value buy fee at entry FX and each sell fee at its own FX. Independently derive signed gross/net USD, net SOL, total proceeds, fees and net return. No fixed profit ceiling.
financial_contract.primary_shape: realized_qty and realized_proceeds describe only prior partials; the final sale is counted in total cash, not silently added to that prefix. The existing closed-primary net_realized convention deducts all trade fees and is preserved.
financial_contract.legacy: Historical sources are not changed or backfilled. Declared original-FX quoted trades enter this stricter contract. Unquoted synthetic records retain diagnostic compatibility, never executable quote proof; missing or broken declared quoted receipts fail closed.
financial_contract.limitation: Recorded estimated PAPER quotes are not actual live fills, independently authenticated market depth, exhaustive opportunity capture or prospective full-strategy profitability.

population_observation.sql: SELECT closed, COUNT(*) AS positions FROM positions WHERE dry_run=1 GROUP BY closed
population_observation.method: Read-only original-source census and SQLite mode=ro. Zero rows do not establish a financial validation rate or any winning trade.
